selected_threshold_note: Recall-focused threshold maximizes recall while keeping precision >= 0.9 on the held-out test split.
leakage_controls: Exact duplicate email texts are removed before splitting.
A stratified holdout split is created after deduplication.
No raw dataset rows are committed to the repository.
limitations: The public corpus contains historical emails and appears to include spam/social-engineering, not only modern credential phishing.
The split is stratified but not campaign-grouped because the normalized public CSV does not provide campaign IDs.
Metrics are an offline benchmark and do not guarantee production performance on a specific mailbox.
